svg.text: The KV cache turns O(T^2) decoding into O(T)
keys and values for a token never change once computed, so compute them once
every step re-runs k_proj / v_proj over the whole prefix
and every step re-reads the full weight matrices
prefill once, then one new column per step
grey cells are read straight out of the cache
what it costs, per token of context
2 (K and V) x 18 layers x n_kv_heads x 256 x 2 B
Note dim=-2: keys are (B, n_kv_heads, KV_Len, head_dim), so the cache grows along the sequence axis. Each
decode step feeds exactly one query against a steadily longer key/value history - which is why position_ids
for a decode step is a single number rather than a range.
